mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because it connected the cell parts to the muscle’s work and showed the filaments sliding rather than shrinking.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the nuclei into the model felt fairly predictable after making them, although the copied strips passing through pores added useful context.

surprise.text: The final picture changed my understanding by showing that a repeating unit shortens while its individual filaments keep their length.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the named slots and pictures gave each part a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how these working muscle cells are organized into tissues and linked with other body systems. This chapter made the cellular roles clear, though most choices were predictable.
